lines.en: label church20:
scene urbanparadise
Despite continuous signs that I should stop coming here in the form of vanishing rabbits and duct taped eyes, I find myself in disagreement with the world and all that’s happened to me once more.
lines.zh: 尽管不断有迹象表明我不该再来这里——那些迹象化作消失的兔子与被胶带缠住的眼睛——我却再一次发现，自己与这个世界、与自己身上发生的一切格格不入。

lines.en: Though, this time, instead of my legs moving themselves, it is a conscious decision that I have made.
lines.zh: 不过这一次，不再是双腿自作主张地迈步，而是我自己有意识做出的决定。

lines.en: I could turn around at any moment if I truly wanted to.
lines.zh: 如果我真的想，随时都可以转身离去。

lines.en: So why don’t I want to?
lines.zh: 那我为什么不想呢？

lines.en: Where does this subconscious compulsion to meet with a girl—who, despite maintaining constant eye contact, will never see eye to eye with me—come from?
lines.zh: 这种潜意识的冲动究竟从何而来——要去见一个女孩，她明明始终与我四目相对，却永远无法与我看法一致？

lines.en: And why is the path to her always so devoid of everything but unwelcome sounds and sweat droplets trickling down my chest before being consumed by my clothing?
lines.zh: 而通往她的这条路，为何除了一阵阵不受欢迎的声响、以及顺着胸口淌下、随后被衣衫吸干的汗珠之外，总是空无一物？

lines.en: I think for a moment that maybe tonight will be different.
lines.zh: 有一瞬间我觉得，也许今晚会不一样。

lines.en: And that maybe I will find Yasu outside of her church and we’ll leave this place and learn who each other really are.
lines.zh: 也许我会在教堂之外遇见 Yasu，然后我们离开这里，去认识彼此真正的模样。

lines.en: But the chances of that are unlikely.
lines.zh: 但这种可能性微乎其微。

lines.en: Not because we are predictable creatures who dance on the puppet strings of thoughts or beings we cannot see-
lines.zh: 并不是因为我们是些可预测的生物，在我们看不见的思想或存在的提线上翩翩起舞——

lines.en: But because we're incapable of being anything {i}but{/i} that.
lines.zh: 而是因为我们根本{i}无力{/i}成为别的任何样子。

lines.en: So there is nothing left to learn about one another as we have not yet squeezed our way out of our respective cocoons.
lines.zh: 既然我们都还没能从各自的茧里挤出来，那彼此之间也就没什么可了解的了。

lines.en: And so long as our shells are wrapped tightly in the invisible threads of our masters, we will not break free.
lines.zh: 只要我们的壳还被主人那些看不见的丝线紧紧缠住，我们就无法挣脱。

lines.en: The one who controls Yasu keeps her strings firm and taut.
lines.zh: 操控 Yasu 的那一位，把她的线绷得又紧又直。

lines.en: And the one who controls me can’t figure out how to untangle them.
lines.zh: 而操控我的那一位，却始终理不清该怎么解开它们。

lines.en: scene black
A small hole appears in the wall of my subconscious.
lines.zh: 我潜意识的墙壁上裂开一个小洞。

lines.en: I press my hands to its edges and pull it open as wide as I can.
lines.zh: 我把双手抵在洞的边缘，尽力把它撑开到最大。

lines.en: Its insides smell like rotting wormwood.
lines.zh: 里面闻起来像腐烂的苦艾。

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch1
: Ngh!
: Let...me in!
lines.zh: : 让……我进去！

lines.en: : I...belong inside!
lines.zh: : 我……属于里面！

lines.en: : I have no use out here!
lines.zh: : 我在外面毫无用处！

lines.en: : Let me in! Let me in! Let...me in!
lines.zh: : 让我进去！让我进去！让……我进去！

lines.en: Huh.
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: It appears that maybe tonight {i}will{/i} be different after all.
lines.zh: 看来今晚{i}或许{/i}终究会不一样。

lines.en: I find Yasu desperately fighting against the handle of the church door, attempting to leverage what little body weight she has to pry it open. But all to no avail.
lines.zh: 我发现 Yasu 正拼命跟教堂门的把手较劲，想用她那点可怜的体重把它撬开。但一切都是徒劳。

lines.en: She struggles, much like a fish out of water.
lines.zh: 她挣扎着，像一条离了水的鱼。

lines.en: And though she may lack the necessary amount of slits in her neck to take in oxygen, the one she has much further down below is sure to bring her more joy than any amount of released carbon dioxide would.
lines.zh: 虽说她脖子上没有足够多的裂口来摄入氧气，但她再往下一点的那一道，必定能带给她比呼出再多二氧化碳都更多的欢愉。

lines.en: Perhaps this sudden rejection at the hands of her god will be the motivation she needs to finally use it?
lines.zh: 也许这突如其来的、来自她的神的拒绝，正是她终于肯用上它所需要的动力？

lines.en: : I will repent for my sins! I will repent for my sins!
lines.zh: : 我要为我的罪忏悔！我要为我的罪忏悔！

lines.en: : I did not mean to sully your great name, heavenly Father! I did not mean any harm at all!
lines.zh: : 我并非有意玷污您的圣名，天父！我绝无半点恶意！

lines.en: : If I have done wrong, strike me down! For I belong nowhere if not inside!
lines.zh: : 若我真的做错了，就劈死我吧！因为除了里面，我无处可归！

lines.en: : I know you not as a cruel and callous god, but as a forgiving and loving one! And that all who wish to enter, may!
lines.zh: : 我所认识的你，不是残忍冷漠的神，而是宽恕而慈爱的神！凡愿意进来的，都可以进来！

lines.en: : So why?! Why must you keep me out here?!
lines.zh: : 那为什么呢？！你为什么非要把我关在外面？！

lines.en: : Tell me, Father! What must I do?!
lines.zh: : 告诉我，天父！我该怎么做？！

lines.en: : Scream it loud enough that it pierces the veil! Loud enough to penetrate this plague of locusts with a plague of your own!
lines.zh: : 把它喊得响亮到能刺穿帷幕！响亮到能用你自己的灾祸穿透这场蝗灾！

lines.en: : Let me in!
lines.zh: : 让我进去！

lines.en: : Let...me in!
lines.zh: : 让……我进去！

lines.en: : Yasu...I don’t think you’re going to be able to get in there if someone locked the door.
lines.zh: : Yasu……如果有人把门锁了，我觉得你是进不去的。

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch2
: It can’t be locked! It wouldn’t make sense!
lines.zh: : 不可能上锁！这说不通！

lines.en: : The hands of mortals who do not accept Him are not strong enough to move these doors!
lines.zh: : 不接受祂的凡人之手，是没有力气推动这扇门的！

lines.en: : I don’t accept him and I move these doors all the time.
lines.zh: : 我也不接受祂，可我推这些门推得可勤了。

lines.en: : Someone’s probably just fucking with you.
lines.zh: : 大概只是有人故意耍你罢了。

lines.en: : No! No, that is not possible!
lines.zh: : 不！不，这不可能！

lines.en: : This is divine punishment! I have strayed from my path and am being forced aside!
lines.zh: : 这是神的惩罚！我偏离了正道，所以被推到一边！

lines.en: : I must repent! I must repent!
lines.zh: : 我必须忏悔！我必须忏悔！

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch3
: Let me in!
lines.zh: : 让我进去！

lines.en: : I will right all of my wrongs! Whatever they may be! Just give me a sign! Let me hear your voice!
lines.zh: : 我会弥补我犯下的所有过错！不管那是什么过错！只要给我一个启示！让我听见你的声音！

lines.en: While the idea of someone going out of their way to lock these doors seems like the most likely scenario, it’s important to note that I’ve never really {i}seen{/i} anyone around here.
lines.zh: 虽然「有人特意绕过来把门锁上」这个设想看起来最有可能，但值得注意的是，我其实从未在这附近{i}见过{/i}任何人。

lines.en: And with Yasu spending virtually all of her free time inside of this building, it would mean that they would have had to come in one of the rare windows of time in which she’s absent.
lines.zh: 而 Yasu 几乎把所有空闲时间都耗在这栋建筑里，这就意味着他们只能挑她不在的那一小段罕见空档下手。

lines.en: But that begs to question- why?
lines.zh: 但这就引出了一个问题——为什么？

lines.en: What would someone have to gain from closing off an old church building used by no one but a young girl with knotted hair and several screws loose?
lines.zh: 封掉一栋除了一个头发打结、脑子缺根弦的年轻女孩之外没人使用的旧教堂，究竟能捞到什么好处？

lines.en: What will become of Yasu when she realizes that prayer alone will not get her what she wants?
lines.zh: 当 Yasu 意识到光靠祈祷并不能替她换来她想要的东西时，她会变成什么样？

lines.en: And that any time it {i}had{/i} in the past was just a convenient coincidence.
lines.zh: 而过去那些{i}灵验{/i}的时刻，不过是恰好赶上的巧合。

lines.en: The same way this meeting is.
lines.zh: 就像这次的相遇一样。

lines.en: scene black
For me and not for her, of course.
lines.zh: 当然，这只是我的相遇，不是她的。

lines.en: I got what I wanted and the only thing lost was a sliver of sanity in a girl who does not possess much to begin with.
lines.zh: 我得到了我想要的，唯一的代价，是一个本就没剩多少理智的女孩又碎掉了一小片理智。

lines.en: It reminds me of something a rabbit once said about gifts.
lines.zh: 这让我想起一只兔子曾经说过的、关于礼物的某句话。

lines.en: But if this is a gift from an unlikely sponsor—the same one watched by a girl with blue eyes—why am I the one benefiting when all I have done thus far is doubt?
lines.zh: 但如果这是一份来自某个意想不到的赞助者的礼物——就是那个被蓝眼睛女孩注视着的同一位——为什么迄今为止我除了怀疑什么都没做，受益的反而是我？

lines.en: And why is the one who follows so closely behind the guiding light the one caught in darkness?
lines.zh: 而为什么，那个紧紧追随引导之光的人，反而被困在黑暗里？

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch4
: Help me open the door!
lines.zh: : 帮我把门打开！

lines.en: : It may be closed for me, but it would never close for you!
lines.zh: : 它或许会为我而关，但绝不会为你而关！

lines.en: : It’s locked, Yasu. It’s not going to make a difference {i}who{/i} tries to open it right now.
lines.zh: : 门是锁着的，Yasu。现在不管是{i}谁{/i}去推，都不会有什么区别。

lines.en: : You don’t know that! You don’t know the way He works!
lines.zh: : 你不懂！你不懂祂行事的方式！

lines.en: : This may just be my inner “expert sinner” talking, but wouldn’t it be {i}bad{/i} if you were to sneak back into the church if your god truly is the one locking you out?
lines.zh: : 也许只是我内心的“资深罪人”在发言，但如果真的是你的神把你锁在门外，你再偷偷溜回教堂，岂不是{i}不太好{/i}？

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch5
: He will forgive me! For in His light I walk! And all that I am is the result of all He allows me to be!
lines.zh: : 祂会宽恕我的！因为我行在祂的光中！我之所以是我，全都是祂允许我成为的样子！

lines.en: : Though the darkness hath clung to my coattails, I have shaken them off and am ready for His touch of reluctant purification!
lines.zh: : 尽管黑暗曾紧紧拽住我的衣摆，我已将它抖落，准备好领受祂那不情愿的净化之触！

lines.en: : I will be clean again! I will!
lines.zh: : 我会重新变得洁净！我会的！

lines.en: : What did you even do to become {i}unclean?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你到底做了什么，才变得{i}不洁净{/i}的？

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch6
: I do not know. And I {i}can not{/i} know as His voice has retreated behind these doors.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。而我{i}无法{/i}知道，因为祂的声音已经退到了这些门后。

lines.en: : The only change to my life that I can recall sprung from the pages of the books that I read!
lines.zh: : 我所能记起的、生活里唯一的变化，源自我读过的那些书的书页！

lines.en: : But those books were free from the tainted and misconceived depictions of life that true sinners indulge in!
lines.zh: : 可那些书里并没有真正的罪人所沉溺的那种污秽而谬误的生活描写！

lines.en: : What I did should be allowed!
lines.zh: : 我所做的事应该是被允许的！

lines.en: : There are no rules against entertainment! There are no rules against fun!
lines.zh: : 没有任何戒律禁止娱乐！没有任何戒律禁止享乐！

lines.en: : And yet I find myself abandoned!
lines.zh: : 可我却发现自己被抛弃了！

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch7
: Do you know what happens to a duckling who loses its mother?
lines.zh: : 你知道一只失去母亲的小鸭会怎样吗？

lines.en: : Doesn’t it just...latch onto whoever it sees next?
lines.zh: : 不就是……黏上它接下来看到的随便什么人吗？

lines.en: : Yes. But if the replacement animal or human does not understand what the duck requires to survive and grow, then what?
lines.zh: : 是的。但如果顶替上来的那只动物或那个人，并不明白这只鸭子生存和长大需要什么，那会怎样？

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我不知道——

lines.en: : It dies.
lines.zh: : 它会死。

lines.en: : I thought that nothing ever “dies” in your religion?
lines.zh: : 我还以为在你们的宗教里，什么都不会“死”呢？

lines.en: : That which is abandoned can. For He is the one who binds the planes together with fishing wire.
lines.zh: : 被抛弃的可以。因为是祂用钓鱼线把这些层面缝合在一起的。

lines.en: : And if he willfully decides that one can not fit in the space between them, there is nowhere left for that person to go.
lines.zh: : 如果祂执意认定某个人无法容身于它们之间的缝隙，那这个人就再也没有地方可去了。

lines.en: : I am caught, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我被困住了，Sensei。

lines.en: : Tangled up in wires.
lines.zh: : 纠缠在丝线里。

lines.en: : I must-
lines.zh: : 我必须——

lines.en: : Be-
: Unraveled.
lines.zh: : 解开。

lines.en: : Well, you’re not going to get “unraveled” by just waiting outside a building you can’t get into. So why don’t we...go for a walk and help you clear your mind or something?
lines.zh: : 好吧，光在一栋你进不去的建筑外面干等着，你是不会“被解开”的。要不我们……去散个步，帮你清醒一下脑子什么的？

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch8
: A...walk?
: But where?
lines.zh: : 可去哪里？

lines.en: : The world as we know it has been stripped away from us.
lines.zh: : 我们所知的那个世界，已经从我们身上被剥走了。

lines.en: : Everything is already g-
lines.zh: : 一切都已经消——

lines.en: : The world is still here, Yasu. Just because you won’t be able to see your normal hangout spot from wherever we’re going doesn’t mean that everything has vanished.
lines.zh: : 世界还在这儿，Yasu。不能因为从我们要去的地方看不到你平时常待的那个据点，就意味着一切都消失了。

lines.en: : But...where {i}are{/i} we going?
lines.zh: : 可……我们{i}到底{/i}要去哪儿？

lines.en: : What sort of place will accept me the way I am?
lines.zh: : 什么样的地方会接纳我现在的样子？

lines.en: : Wherever I take you, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我带你去哪儿，就是哪儿吧。

lines.en: : Is that a problem?
lines.zh: : 这有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : I do not know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : I have lost my mother duck...
lines.zh: : 我失去了我的鸭妈妈……

lines.en: : Then make your own decision for once in your life instead of waiting for someone else to make one for you.
lines.zh: : 那就这辈子头一回自己做一次决定，而不是等着别人替你做。

lines.en: : What you ask of me...is to both lead and follow at the same time.
lines.zh: : 你对我提出的要求……是要我同时既引领又跟随。

lines.en: : I think choosing to follow can be its own form of leading.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，选择跟随本身也可以是一种引领。

lines.en: : But only when it's directed at {i}you{/i} and not the true god?
lines.zh: : 但前提是这个方向指向{i}你{/i}，而不是真正的神？

lines.en: : Do you see yourself as an interim deity? Are you truly so elevated?
lines.zh: : 你把自己看作一位临时的神明吗？你真有那么高高在上？

lines.en: : I see myself as someone who is about to walk away with or without you.
lines.zh: : 我把自己看作一个不管你跟不跟、都准备要走的人。

lines.en: : So follow me or don’t. This choice is yours.
lines.zh: : 所以跟不跟，随你。这个选择是你的。

lines.en: : But if you plan on sticking around here and trying to pry those doors open all night, the only thing you’re going to find is further frustration and heartbreak.
lines.zh: : 但如果你打算留在这儿、整晚试着把那些门撬开，那你唯一会找到的，就是更多的挫败和心碎。

lines.en: : At least {i}I{/i} won’t willfully abandon you.
lines.zh: : 至少{i}我{/i}不会故意抛弃你。

lines.en: scene black
I turn around and, just as expected, Yasu clings to my side like the desperate prey she is- hiding under the cover of someone more powerful just because they have an idea of where they want to go.
lines.zh: 我转过身，正如预料的那样，Yasu 像她本就是的那只绝望猎物一样紧贴在我身侧——只因为对方知道该往哪儿走，便躲进某个更强者的庇护之下。

lines.en: And so I take her into the darkest alley I can find.
lines.zh: 于是我带着她走进我能找到的最暗的一条小巷。

lines.en: Not so I can defile her holy, virgin body-
lines.zh: 不是为了玷污她圣洁的处子之身——

lines.en: But so she understands that power does not come from the light alone.
lines.zh: 而是为了让她明白，力量并非只来自光。

lines.en: And that sometimes, it’s easier to see in the dark.
lines.zh: 也让她明白，有时候在黑暗里反而看得更清楚。

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch9
Vines sprawl out and make their home on the same damp, concrete wall we press our backs against.
lines.zh: 藤蔓肆意蔓延，在我们背靠着的那面潮湿水泥墙上安了家。

lines.en: The smell of mildew spreads throughout the alley, its scent almost pulsing- coming in waves where it turns from bearable to nauseating in the blink of an eye.
lines.zh: 霉味在整条小巷里弥散开来，那气味几乎是搏动着的——一波一波涌来，转瞬之间就从尚可忍受变成令人作呕。

lines.en: I distract myself from the need to vomit by focusing on a girl who’s able to ignore the scent entirely.
lines.zh: 为了不去想呕吐的冲动，我把注意力集中在一个能完全无视这股气味的女孩身上。

lines.en: I imagine this is not the first time she’s spent the late hours pressed up against a damp concrete wall.
lines.zh: 我想，这大概不是她第一次在深夜里紧贴着潮湿的水泥墙度过了。

lines.en: In fact, I imagine this feels more like home to her than a warm bed in a locked room.
lines.zh: 事实上，我觉得这对她来说，比一间上锁房间里温暖的床更像家。

lines.en: It’s the only thing that makes her lack of fear right now plausible when many others in her position would attempt to distance themselves.
lines.zh: 这也是她此刻毫无惧意唯一说得通的解释——换成许多和她处境相同的人，早就设法拉开距离了。

lines.en: Yasu pulls her knees to her chest- not because she is scared and defensive.
lines.zh: Yasu 把双膝收到胸前——不是因为她害怕、在防备。

lines.en: But because, even in this intense summer heat, the only warmth she will let in is that which belongs to her god.
lines.zh: 而是因为，即便在这酷烈的暑热里，她唯一愿意接纳的温暖，是属于她的神的那种。

lines.en: And despite my desire to become that for her, it is still far too soon.
lines.zh: 而我尽管渴望成为她的那份温暖，现在还远远太早。
: 那么……

lines.en: : I take it nothing like that has ever happened before?
lines.zh: : 我看，那种事以前从来没发生过吧？

lines.en: : I have been the purest of the pure. There was no reason to bar me from entry until recently.
lines.zh: : 我一直是最纯洁的纯洁者。直到最近之前，都没有任何理由把我拦在门外。

lines.en: : There was no reason to bar you from entry {i}tonight{/i} either, though. Right?
lines.zh: : 不过{i}今晚{/i}也没有理由拦你进门吧？对吗？

lines.en: : There must be something. Something I have yet to understand.
lines.zh: : 一定有某个缘由。某个我尚未明白的缘由。

lines.en: : Something that I must come to terms with so that I can return home.
lines.zh: : 某个我必须接受、才能回家的东西。

lines.en: : You have another home now, though. One significantly warmer and less creepy. Hell, it even comes with an extremely hot and generous rich girl.
lines.zh: : 可你现在有另一个家了。一个暖和得多、也没那么阴森的家。见鬼，那儿甚至还附赠一个火辣又大方的富家千金。

lines.en: : That’s where I’d be spending {i}all{/i} of my time if I were you.
lines.zh: : 如果我是你，我{i}所有{/i}的时间都会耗在那儿。

lines.en: : But you are not me.
lines.zh: : 可你不是我。

lines.en: : You resist the light when I require it to move forward.
lines.zh: : 你抗拒那光，而我却需要它才能继续前行。

lines.en: : It is the reason I still persist today. The reason I can open my eyes.
lines.zh: : 那是我至今仍在坚持的理由。是我还能睁开眼睛的理由。

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch10
: I take it you won’t actually tell me about how things were before that, will you?
lines.zh: : 我看你是不会真的告诉我那之前的事了，对吧？

lines.en: : There is no me before the me I am today.
lines.zh: : 在今天的我之外，没有另一个我。

lines.en: : I am but a product of Him alone. An angel in training that lives to serve, even while I am falling to the ground.
lines.zh: : 我只是祂一人的产物。一个见习中的天使，为侍奉而生，哪怕我正在坠向地面。

lines.en: : But you were someone else {i}before{/i} that.
lines.zh: : 可{i}在那之前{/i}，你曾是另一个人。

lines.en: : And so were you.
lines.zh: : 你也一样。

lines.en: : The reasons you do not speak of your past self may not be different from those which belong to me.
lines.zh: : 你不愿谈及过去那个自己的理由，或许和我的并没有什么不同。

lines.en: : In all fairness, you’ve never really given me the opportunity to speak of my past self around you.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，在你面前，你可从没真正给过我谈过去那个自己的机会。

lines.en: : Would you if I did?
lines.zh: : 如果我给了，你会说吗？

lines.en: : That’s...a little complicated.
lines.zh: : 这个……有点复杂。

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch11
: Yes...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : It is, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 确实，不是吗？

lines.en: : You have so many secrets that even the air struggles to hold them.
lines.zh: : 你的秘密多到连空气都难以承载。

lines.en: : It is why I know more about you than you will ever understand about me.
lines.zh: : 所以我知道的关于你的事，永远多过你能理解的关于我的事。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Then...what do you know?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？那……你都知道些什么？

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch12
: I know that tragedy would befall each and every one of us if I were to share that information with you.
lines.zh: : 我知道，如果我把那些事告诉你，悲剧就会降临到我们每一个人的头上。

lines.en: : That sounds a lot like a convenient excuse to make up for the fact that you’re just bullshitting me right now.
lines.zh: : 这听起来很像是一个顺手的借口，用来掩饰你此刻只是在对我胡说八道。

lines.en: : If that is what you believe, then that is what you believe.
lines.zh: : 如果你这么相信，那就是这么相信吧。

lines.en: : But that is where our biggest difference lies.
lines.zh: : 但这正是我们最大的分歧所在。

lines.en: : All you {i}can{/i} do is believe. But all I can do is {i}know.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}能{/i}做的只有相信。而我能做的只有{i}知晓{/i}。

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch13
: The secrets of this world and everyone in it glitter like diamonds.
lines.zh: : 这个世界、以及世上每一个人的秘密，都像钻石一样闪闪发光。

lines.en: : The stars are not real. They are the residue of hopes and wishes. Dreams and desires.
lines.zh: : 星辰并不真实。它们是希望与心愿的残迹。是梦与欲的残迹。

lines.en: : And when we gaze up at them with our undeserving eyes, we are gazing at the past itself and each and every trace left behind during a departure from one plane to the next.
lines.zh: : 当我们用这不配的眼睛仰望它们时，我们望见的正是过去本身，以及从一个层面离开、前往下一个层面时留下的每一道痕迹。

lines.en: : Would you believe me if I told you of the stars below us as well?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你，我们脚下也有星辰，你会信吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t believe you no matter what you told me about literally anything.
lines.zh: : 不管你跟我说任何事，我都不会信。

lines.en: : Even when that’s all you can do? When I {i}know?{/i}
lines.zh: : 即便相信是你唯一能做的事？即便我{i}确知{/i}？

lines.en: : Yes. Because we have actual scientific explanations for the stars and I have a hard time believing that the key to everything is the endless rambling of a cult member.
lines.zh: : 是的。因为我们对星辰有确凿的科学解释，而我很难相信，解开一切的钥匙竟是一个邪教成员没完没了的胡言乱语。

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch14
: A cult is full of members. I am but {i}one{/i} measly soul- filled with nothing but messages too painfully true for those around me to grasp.
lines.zh: : 邪教里满是成员。而我只是{i}一个{/i}微不足道的灵魂——体内装满了过于真实、真实到令周围的人无法领会的讯息。

lines.en: : Those unlike you.
lines.zh: : 不像你的那些人。

lines.en: : But your palms will open soon enough. And in them, I will place little shards of His truth. A truth that will change the way you perceive your life.
lines.zh: : 但你的掌心很快就会张开。到那时，我会把祂真理的小小碎片放进去。那份真理会改变你看待自己人生的方式。

lines.en: : Soon, you will forget how to swim.
lines.zh: : 很快，你就会忘记怎么游泳。

lines.en: : And as your head falls beneath the surface of the water, you will understand just how much His protection means.
lines.zh: : 当你的头沉到水面之下，你就会明白祂的庇护有多重要。

lines.en: : The tide is rising, Child of Man. A torrential downpour looms on the horizon.
lines.zh: : 潮水正在上涨，人之子。一场倾盆暴雨正逼近地平线。

lines.en: : He can teach you how to swim once more. He can lift you up when the water starts to fill your lungs.
lines.zh: : 祂能重新教会你游泳。当水开始灌进你的肺，祂能把你托起来。

lines.en: : I thought you couldn’t hear him any-
lines.zh: : 我还以为你听不见祂了呢——

lines.en: : I have heard this so many times that it is engraved into the back of my mind like initials on a tree.
lines.zh: : 这些话我听过太多次，早已刻进我脑海深处，就像刻在树上的姓名缩写。

lines.en: : You are popular in more than one plane, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你在不止一个层面上都很受欢迎，Sensei。

lines.en: : Your entire being transcends that which grounds the world.
lines.zh: : 你的整个存在，都超越了那将世界锚定的东西。

lines.en: : Your failure to accept that would be a sin if it were anyone else.
lines.zh: : 换作别人，不接受这一点就是罪。

lines.en: : But {i}you-{/i}
: You are His favorite.
lines.zh: : 你是祂最钟爱的那一个。

lines.en: : Even though you deny Him so.
lines.zh: : 尽管你如此否认祂。

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch15
: Yeah, well...maybe if gods weren’t such fucking pricks I’d be more inclined to believe in them.
lines.zh: : 是啊，好吧……也许如果神不是这么些该死的混蛋，我倒会更愿意信一信。

lines.en: : Do not fear, for I will make you believe.
lines.zh: : 不要怕，因为我会让你相信。

lines.en: : And in me, you will find reason to persist.
lines.zh: : 而在我身上，你会找到坚持下去的理由。

lines.en: : Though the doors may be closed tonight, the quieting of the insects has provided an opportunity for me to catch His whispers once more.
lines.zh: : 虽然今晚门或许关着，但虫鸣的平息给了我一个机会，让我再次捕捉到祂的低语。

lines.en: : I do not know if He wants me to have them, but I am His humble servant and would willingly give my life to make His better.
lines.zh: : 我不知道祂是否愿意让我听见，但我是祂谦卑的仆人，愿意献出我的生命，好让祂的变得更好。

lines.en: : Soon, I will help you understand.
lines.zh: : 很快，我会帮你明白。

lines.en: : Soon, you will have no reason to doubt me.
lines.zh: : 很快，你就再没有理由怀疑我。

lines.en: scene yasuoutsidechurch16
: Soon, it will all be revealed!
lines.zh: : 很快，一切都会被揭示！

lines.en: : He will rise from the ground! Coated in the thick residue of dreams deterred! With arms spread wide, beckoning us forward!
lines.zh: : 祂将从地里升起！浑身裹着被阻挠的梦那浓稠的残渍！双臂大张，召唤我们向前！

lines.en: : He will take us under his wings and we will return to where we belong! Clinging to his feathers as he reminds us that we are eternally loved so long as we obey!
lines.zh: : 祂会把我们接到翅膀底下，我们就回到属于我们的地方！紧紧抓住祂的羽毛，祂会提醒我们，只要我们顺从，就会被永远爱着！

lines.en: : The snow has gone! It quiets his screaming no longer!
lines.zh: : 雪已经消逝！它再也无法压住祂的尖叫！

lines.en: : The light returns! The light returns!
lines.zh: : 光回来了！光回来了！

lines.en: : And soon-
lines.zh: : 而很快——

lines.en: : So will we!
lines.zh: : 我们也会！

lines.en: scene black
I stop paying attention to everything Yasu says somewhere in the middle of her speech.
lines.zh: 在 Yasu 这番话讲到一半的某个地方，我就不再去听她说的任何内容了。

lines.en: I had thought this was finally going to be an opportunity to learn more about her.
lines.zh: 我本以为这一次终于能有机会多了解她一些。

lines.en: About the {i}real{/i} her.
lines.zh: 了解{i}真正的{/i}她。

lines.en: Or, as she would likely put it- the her that isn’t {i}her{/i} anymore.
lines.zh: 或者，按她大概的说法——那个已经不再是{i}她{/i}的她。

lines.en: But I guess that’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: 但看来是不会发生了。

lines.en: And I guess that if it ever {i}will{/i}-
lines.zh: 而我想，如果它{i}真的会{/i}发生——

lines.en: It won’t be anywhere near here.
lines.zh: 也不会是在这附近的任何地方。

lines.en: I should have taken her to a darker alley, further away.
lines.zh: 我本该带她去一条更暗、更远的小巷。

lines.en: I should have taken her somewhere the wind could not reach.
lines.zh: 我本该带她去一个风到不了的地方。

lines.en: Somewhere underground.
lines.zh: 某个地下的地方。

lines.en: Beneath the blanket of dreams deterred.
lines.zh: 在被阻挠的梦织成的毯子之下。
